text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Haa... haa...
...N-Not yet, I can keep going—

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Oh, look who it is, Verxina-chan.
Good work! You're super fired up, huh~?

In the evening, I spotted Tosen Jordan and
Verxina talking by the track.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Oh—
Good work to you as well, Jordan-san.
Later, when I stopped by the school store—

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
The one she said she wanted to try
was this one, if I remember correctly...? No, but maybe—

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
—Whoa. Crazy.
Wait, aren't you buying a ton? Isn't that way too much?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
—! Ah, yes,
I always bring care packages for my little sisters.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
I meant to just pick up a few health foods today,
and before I knew it—it ended up like this.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
For real? Insane~
Your big-sister energy is off the charts~~~...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I've got a little sister too, but I'm totally not like that.
I haven't done anything for her at all.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Is that so? But looking at it another way,
doesn't that just mean she's very self-reliant?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, I guess! She's my pride and joy!
Though how should I put it—

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Aaaaagh~~~~~~...!
Alright, that's it for today...!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Ah, a notification...?
'Sis, how're you doing?'

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Man~~... right now is pretty rough.
...............Guess I can reply later.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...Kinda like that, y'know?
Especially when I'm wiped out, I'm just hopeless.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I end up putting it off. Well, even if I forced a reply,
I probably wouldn't say anything helpful anyway.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Even if you force yourself—
...Yes, that is true.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
...I wish I could be
more like you, Jordan-san.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
To tell the truth, I couldn't remember what
my sisters wanted... so I was pushing myself
and overbuying.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Acting for the sake of others is something
that should only come after one has grounded oneself.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
To think I had forgotten something so fundamental...
Thank you for helping me realize that,
Jordan-san.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I don't really get it, but...
you're feeling better now, so all good, right?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Fufu, yes. I shall start by taking a break myself.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Fr?! Wanna hit up a cafe together then?!
There's this frappe I totally recommend right now!

...It seems Tosen Jordan casually speaking her true thoughts
gave Verxina a moment of clarity.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Ah, by the way~,
are you fine wrapping up your shopping like this~?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Couldn't you just ask them right now?
Like, what your sisters actually want!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
...! You are right...!
Please excuse me for a moment. I will make a quick call.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Well, the truth is...
I love sweet treats as well.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Fr?! Then you're definitely gonna love it!
You can customize it and everything~~!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, then I shall look forward to you teaching me all about it.
Fufu♪
